item.title: Henshin ☆ a la Maid
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: FlyingShine Kotobuki
  • 発売日: 2005-01-28
  • スコア: 6.38/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: へんしん☆ア・ラ・メイド
  • 英語名: Henshin ☆ a la Maid

あらすじ

Shinjo Akemi is a director of Shinjo Institute. A mysterious creature arrives from space to rule the Earth. It aims to deprive humanity of its best weapon - battle suit “a la Maid”. For that it’s going take away three maid stones.

Akemi chooses three girls from all over the world to fight the impostor in battle suits imbued with pure maid feelings.
